200.description:
One NCBI Gene record, by GeneID (`7157`), by official symbol or alias in an organism (`symbol`, with `organism` defaulting to human, 9606), or by an ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene URL: symbol, aliases and full name, NCBI summary with who provided it and when, chromosome and genomic locations, RefSeqGene, MANE/RefSeq Select and other RefSeq transcripts with Ensembl IDs, GeneRIF PubMed IDs, and UniProt, Ensembl, HGNC/MGI and OMIM IDs. `resolution` says how the input matched; replaced GeneIDs are followed and reported, and an alias several genes share returns `gene: null` with the `candidates`. Unknown, discontinued and wrong-organism inputs are `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `candidates` | object[] | Other genes the symbol names: every gene when it is ambiguous, otherwise the other holders of the symbol as an alias. Empty for GeneID input. |
| `gene` | object | The gene; null when the symbol is an alias of several genes (see `candidates`). |
| `license` | object | NCBI places no restrictions on the use or distribution of NCBI Gene data and asks for acknowledgment; submitters of some underlying data may claim rights. Show the attribution and the record's `source_url` when you reuse it. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | When the program read the source, Unix milliseconds. |
| `resolution` | object | How the input was matched to a gene. |

summary.text: This gene encodes a tumor suppressor protein containing transcriptional activation, DNA binding, and oligomerization domains. The encoded protein responds to diverse cellular stresses to regulate expression of target genes, thereby inducing cell cycle arrest, apoptosis, senescence, DNA repair, or changes in metabolism. Mutations in this gene are associated with a variety of human cancers, including hereditary cancers such as Li-Fraumeni syndrome. Alternative splicing of this gene and the use of alternate promoters result in multiple transcript variants and isoforms. Additional isoforms have also been shown to result from the use of alternate translation initiation codons from identical transcript variants (PMIDs: 12032546, 20937277). [provided by RefSeq, Dec 2016]

200.description:
Orthologs of one gene from NCBI's ortholog sets: give the gene as for `get` (`gene_id`, `symbol` with `organism`, or `url`) and optionally `taxa` (taxonomy IDs or names at any rank: `mouse`, `Danio rerio`, `rodents`) to keep only those organisms. Each ortholog is a gene row with GeneID, symbol, organism, location and cross-references, in NCBI's order; the set pages with `limit` and `offset`. A gene without orthologs, or none in the taxa, returns an empty list.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `orthologs` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aliases` | string[] | Other symbols the gene is known by (`P53`, `LFS1`). |
| `chromosomes` | string[] | Chromosomes the gene is on (`17`; `X` and `Y` for pseudoautosomal genes); empty when unplaced or unknown. |
| `current_gene_id` | string | For a `replaced` record, the GeneID that replaced it; otherwise null. |
| `ensembl_gene_ids` | string[] | Ensembl gene IDs, e.g. `ENSG00000141510`. |
| `gene_id` | string | NCBI GeneID (Entrez Gene ID), e.g. `7157`; pass it to `get` or `orthologs`. |
| `map_location` | string | Cytogenetic location, e.g. `17p13.1` (human) or `11 B3` (mouse); null when NCBI has none. |
| `name` | string | Full gene name, e.g. `tumor protein p53`. |
| `nomenclature` | object | The official nomenclature record: authority and its ID (HGNC:11998 for human, MGI:98834 for mouse, ZFIN, RGD, FlyBase, EcoCyc...). Null when no authority names the gene. |
| `omim_ids` | string[] | OMIM gene entry numbers (human genes), e.g. `191170`. |
| `organism` | object | The organism the gene belongs to. |
| `source_url` | string | The gene's page on NCBI Gene, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/<gene_id>, for attribution and follow-up. |
| `status` | string | `live` for current records; `replaced` and `discontinued` appear only with `include_discontinued`. |
| `symbol` | string | Official gene symbol, e.g. `TP53` (human), `Trp53` (mouse), `tp53` (zebrafish); `LOC` symbols for genes without an official name. |
| `type` | string | Gene type in snake_case: `protein_coding`, `ncrna`, `pseudogene`, `trna`, `rrna`, `snrna`, `scrna`, `snorna`, `misc_rna`, `transposon`, `biological_region`, `other` or `unknown`. Null for replaced or discontinued records, which come from Entrez summaries. |
| `uniprot_ids` | string[] | Reviewed UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot accessions of the encoded proteins, e.g. `P04637`; pass to uniprot-org. |

post.description: To find genes from a name, keyword or partial symbol, or all genes matching a criterion. With a known symbol and organism, `get` resolves the gene directly.

gene_type.description:
Only genes of this type.

Provider reference: allowed values ["protein_coding", "ncrna", "pseudogene", "trna", "rrna", "snrna", "scrna", "snorna", "misc_rna", "biological_region", "other", "unknown"].

include_discontinued.description: Also list replaced and discontinued records (`status` says which; a replaced row names its `current_gene_id`). Default: current genes only.

limit.description:
Results per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50; default 10.

offset.description:
Zero-based index of the first result; pass `next_offset` for the next page.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 1000000; default 0.

organism.description: Only genes of this organism: NCBI taxonomy ID (`9606`) or scientific or common name (`Homo sapiens`, `mouse`, `Danio rerio`). Without it, results span all organisms.

query.description: Free text or Entrez Gene query syntax: a symbol (`BRCA1`), a name (`insulin receptor`), or fielded terms such as `CAP[sym]` (symbol or alias), `TP53[preferred symbol]`, `kinase[Gene/Protein Name]`, `17[chr]`, combined with AND, OR, NOT.
